candidates.original_title: Sequential congruency effects reveal differences in disengagement of attention for monolingual and bilingual young adults
candidates.description: Bilingual adults show a smaller sequential congruency effect than monolingual adults, suggesting bilinguals more efficiently disengage attention from previous stimuli.
